perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.description: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

enhanced.description: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for an improved duration.

perks.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

enhanced.name: Subsistence
enhanced.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves with an increased amount of ammo.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.description: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

enhanced.name: Rangefinder
enhanced.description: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification, and improves handling. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.description: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

enhanced.name: Dragonfly
enhanced.description: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion. Improves reload.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

enhanced.name: Repulsor Brace
enhanced.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield that lasts for an improved duration.

perks.name: Enlightened Action
perks.description: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.

enhanced.name: Enlightened Action
enhanced.description: Dealing damage significantly improves reload speed and handling.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.description: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

enhanced.name: Rapid Hit
enhanced.description: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed substantially.

perks.name: Collective Demolition
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

enhanced.name: Collective Demolition
enhanced.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of improved grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

enhanced.name: Sword Logic
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Focused Fury
perks.description: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

enhanced.name: Focused Fury
enhanced.description: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage for an improved duration. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

enhanced.name: Precision Instrument
enhanced.description: Dealing sustained damage significantly increases precision damage.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

enhanced.name: Rampage
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant increased damage for an improved duration. Stacks 3 times.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Destabilizing Rounds
enhanced.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for an improved duration.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

enhanced.name: Adrenaline Junkie
enhanced.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon for an improved duration.

perks.name: Magnificent Howl
perks.description: The number of precision final blows before reloading affects the total rounds granted with increased range and damage. Precision final blows with Magnificent Howl active extend the effect for additional rounds.

enhanced.name: Magnificent Howl
enhanced.description: The number of precision final blows before reloading affects the total rounds granted with increased range and damage. Precision final blows with Magnificent Howl active extend the effect for additional rounds. Improves reload.

perks.name: Master of Arms

enhanced.name: Master of Arms
enhanced.description: Final blows with any weapon improve this weapon's damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Frenzy
enhanced.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon for an improved duration until you are out of combat.
